hypothesis: The small shared-GRU temporal encoder used by v13/v17 was the only recent learned architecture with positive continuous development net, while the larger TCN follow-ups and their gate/listwise objectives failed. Isolate the architecture effect by keeping the fixed v22 Huber plus pairwise utility ranking objective and using the causal 48-wide GRU over the same five closed-candle frames. All seeds and chronological folds remain mandatory; no threshold, seed or fold tuning.
selection: Fixed16 epochs, all3 seeds x11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed or fold selection and no threshold/portfolio tuning. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, net, coverage and fills. No live approval.
compute: Private free Kaggle T4x2 only for heavy training; local GTX1650 inference/replay/backtests. Do not mutate v19/v21/v22/v23/v25 exports.
